summary: Full-stack interplanetary flight booking system with a React/TypeScript frontend, FastAPI backend supporting both REST and MCP protocols, and SQLite database. Features three seat classes (Economy, Business, Galaxium) with independent availability tracking and dynamic pricing.

frontend.React App (src/App.tsx): Main application entry with routing, user context provider, and layout wrapper
frontend.Pages (src/pages/): Home, Flights browsing with filters, and MyBookings management views
frontend.Components (src/components/): Reusable UI components organized by domain (bookings, flights, layout, user, common)
frontend.API Service (src/services/api.ts): Axios-based HTTP client with interceptors, type-safe endpoints, and error handling
frontend.Types (src/types/): TypeScript definitions for Flight, Booking, User, Quote, Hold, and error responses

backend.FastAPI Server (server.py): Dual-protocol server with REST endpoints and MCP tools, lifespan management for DB init and seeding
backend.Service Layer (services/): Business logic for booking, flight, and user operations returning Union[Success, ErrorResponse]
backend.Database Models (models.py): SQLAlchemy ORM models for User, Flight, Booking with seat class columns and status enum
backend.Database Setup (db.py): SessionLocal factory, engine configuration, defaults to SQLite when DATABASE_URL unset
backend.Seed Data (seed.py): Demo data generator creating 10 users, 10 flights, 20 bookings across all seat classes

dataFlow: User browses flights via React frontend calling GET /flights with optional filters
Frontend displays flights with real-time seat availability per class (economy/business/galaxium)
User registers or logs in via POST /register or GET /user (name + email authentication)
User selects flight and seat class, frontend calls POST /book with user_id, name, flight_id, seat_class
Backend validates user name matches user_id, checks seat availability for specific class, calculates price (base_price * multiplier)
Service decrements correct seat class counter (economy_seats_available, business_seats_available, or galaxium_seats_available)
Booking created with status=booked, price_paid stored, booking returned to frontend
User can view bookings via GET /bookings/{user_id} or cancel via POST /cancel/{booking_id}
Cancellation increments seat counter for the correct class and updates booking status to cancelled
MCP tools provide same functionality for AI agents, manually managing DB sessions outside FastAPI DI

keyFiles.reason: Critical non-obvious patterns that break if ignored: MCP server creation order, SessionLocal patching in tests, name verification requirement, SQLite as production DB, Union return types instead of exceptions
Main backend entry point showing dual-protocol architecture (REST + MCP), lifespan management combining MCP and FastAPI, Java service proxy endpoints, and all API routes
Core booking logic with seat class validation, price calculation using multipliers (1x/2.5x/5x), independent seat counter management, and Union[Success, ErrorResponse] pattern
Complete API client with all endpoints, FlightFilters interface supporting multiple filter styles, error handling via interceptors, and Java hold service integration
Database schema showing three separate seat availability columns per flight, seat_class and price_paid on bookings, and BookingStatus enum with both spellings

entryPoints.add_feature: Start in booking_system_backend/services/ for backend logic (returns Union types), add REST endpoint in server.py, create TypeScript types in frontend/src/types/, add API call in frontend/src/services/api.ts, build UI in frontend/src/components/ or pages/
entryPoints.fix_bug: Check AGENTS.md for non-obvious patterns first. Backend bugs: examine service layer (services/), verify Union return handling, check seat class logic. Frontend bugs: check api.ts error handling (success: false field), verify component state management, inspect browser console for API errors
entryPoints.change_styling: Modify booking_system_frontend/tailwind.config.js for theme colors (cosmic-purple, nebula-pink, etc), edit component CSS in src/components/, adjust global styles in src/index.css, use Tailwind utility classes in TSX files

gotchas: MCP server MUST be created before FastAPI app (line 16 in server.py) or lifespan combination fails
Service functions return Union[SuccessModel, ErrorResponse] not exceptions - always check isinstance(result, ErrorResponse)
book_flight() validates BOTH user_id AND name match - non-standard security pattern that will fail if name is wrong
Tests must monkeypatch BOTH db.SessionLocal AND server.SessionLocal (conftest.py lines 49-50) or MCP tools use wrong session
SQLite is the production database - DATABASE_URL intentionally unset in ECS so db.py defaults to SQLite, data is ephemeral
Frontend checks success: false field not HTTP status codes - error responses return 200 with ErrorResponse body
Each seat class has independent availability counters - must decrement/increment correct field (economy_seats_available, business_seats_available, galaxium_seats_available)
Price multipliers are hardcoded in booking.py - economy 1.0x, business 2.5x, galaxium 5.0x applied to base_price

external_services: Java Inventory Hold Service (optional, proxied via Python backend at /quotes, /holds endpoints)

npm_packages.framer-motion: ^12.26.1 - Animation library for starfield and transitions

runtime_requirements: Environment variable VITE_API_URL for frontend API base URL
Environment variable SEED_DEMO_DATA=true to populate demo data on startup
Environment variable CORS_ORIGINS for allowed origins (defaults to *)
